classification.difficultyReason: Use the equal-side marks to form a perimeter equation, collect like terms and solve for the unknown.

content.prompt: The perimeter of the isosceles triangle is 20. Find $x$.

spec.description: Upright unfilled isosceles triangle with a horizontal base, matching single ticks on the sloping sides, x below the base and x+5 outside the left side. Decorative source blue is replaced by house black.
spec.mathematics: The two sloping sides are equal, so both have length x+5; the base has length x. No units are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; no numerical answer is shown.

answer.worked:
The equal sloping sides each have length $x+5$.

$$\begin{align*}x+(x+5)+(x+5)&=20\\3x+10&=20\\3x&=10\\x&=\frac{10}{3}\\x&=3\frac{1}{3}\end{align*}$$

Check: $\frac{10}{3}+\frac{25}{3}+\frac{25}{3}=20$.
